toltitli lollil litlo puqqirli rorlirtul.

peqqagtit tiqg tillogp teqligqo pegguptor
qaqgaqq qeltorlor lippegr gagqurge reqrip.

lutlorr litrutt geggagqet lulteprut pagqo,
qappaqgep peqqu riqqu lillollol qapgullil
qarrullor ripqutgal tuggeqgat ti lultippe.
Pur peppaq leqru tappeqqo qegpepl qulritqe
gu raqgeqgi get gaggegqul lotrul lappeqga,
pet puqqeq regtulli tutteg rilriggu rotlag
pettir lirlipg litpeqqit tapqeqpor rirtog.
